# One manager, one room, two concurrent manager branches
This fixture is the R32-004 proof for identity, routing, and parent roll-up. Every step repeats the complete routing identity: `principal`, `profile`, `room`, `thread_root`, `work_uid`, `bond`, `parent bond`, and `session`.
The profile is `pf-manager-infra`, the principal is `pr-manager-infra`, and the policy owner is explicit `pr-vp-owner`. The two branches share room `task-auth-14` but never share a thread root, work UID, bond, or native session.

The routing key is `(principal, profile, room, thread_root, work_uid, bond, parent bond, session)`. Room membership alone is insufficient. A cross-profile or cross-host variant is a new assignment and must use the context-transfer request/result/error schemas plus an adapter capability probe; this fixture claims no native cross-profile fork.
